provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 522 E BLANCO RD, BOERNE, TX, 78006

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Wading Pools - Drained Daily and Sanitized: A small wadding pool with rain water from the storm last week was out on the playground.  Note:  The pool was drained and moved off the playground during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Wading Pools - Drained Daily and Sanitized (26 TAC §746.5013(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care: The operation's last fire inspection was conducted on 5/19/25.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care (26 TAC §746.801(11))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- signed dated statement that employee attended abuse/neglect training: One out of eight staff files evaluated did not have an orientation on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- signed dated statement that employee attended abuse/neglect training (26 TAC §746.901(11))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation's last fire inspection was conducted on 4/19/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Enough Available to Prevent Competition: The 2 year old classroom stored extra toys out of the reach of children and had limited items available for use.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Enough Available to Prevent Competition (26 TAC §746.2505(2))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment- If Above Floor Level Must Use Safety Mechanism: The infant changing table did not have an edge around the changing surface.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment- If Above Floor Level Must Use Safety Mechanism (26 TAC §746.3503(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: Location of Handwashing Sink: Soap was not available to children in the 2 year old room.    NOTE: Soap was provided during the inspeciton.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Location of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.4405)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A caregiver left the classroom to answer the door, leaving one caregiver to supervise 18 children in between 2 classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: An infant feeding plan had not been updated since August.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report: A current Health Inspection was not available for inspection.    NOTE: An inspection was scheduled during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report (26 TAC §746.801(12))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: One out of 10 immunization records evaluated was missing an up to date record on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: Two fire extinguishers stored int he vehicles were not secured.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: A fire drill for the month of May had not been recorded.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: A caregiver on the basketball court and in the toddler room were found using their personal phones while in direct supervision of the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: Infant bottles were not labeled with the child's first name and last initial.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During nap time, 3 classrooms were left unattended (Older School-age, Younger School-age and 4/5 yr old rooms) while the three caregivers were in the office.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entrapment Openings: Large climber on the playground had a 1 inch gap on each side of the top of the stairs where two pieces of the equipment meet that could cause a possible entrapment.  Several anchor posts are also missing safety caps on the top of the climber prohibiting children from putting their hands and fingers inside.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entrapment Openings (26 TAC §746.4601(3))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: A red climbing car on the large playground has two tires that have come loose and have exposed screws. A Little Tykes slide on the smaller playground has a brace underneath that is not secured, causing the unit to rock.  A brown climber on the large playground has a cracked area on the platform.  There are numerous pieces of a new climbing unit being stored on the playground that children could potentially climb on and be injured.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing: Two rocking toys and one stationary metal car on the playground had exposed metal anchors which could result in injury if a child should fall upon the metal.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: A caregiver left their classroom to greet the inspector at the front door, relieved the person in charge in their classroom and then returned to their classroom.  The caregiver left the children in her care unattended during this time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: A brown climbing unit and the large climbing unit under the awning on the large playground did not have the required soft surfacing depth around the equipment.  The brown unit had 2 inches of depth on one side of the unit and 0 inches on the other side.  The large climber has a 12 inches of pea gravel directly under the slide and less than an inch of pea gravel around the rest of the unit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: 3 out of 10 child files evaluated did not contain an address for the child's emergency contact person listed on their enrollment form.    NOTE:  The director was able to contact the parents and obtained the missing addresses.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: 1 out of 10 child files evaluated did not have a health statement on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: One caregiver in the Prek room (4 year olds) and one caregiver in the School-age room (ages 6-10 yrs) were in direct care of the children without an eligibility letter on file.  The caregivers were inactivated in 1/19/22  and 9/16/21.    NOTE:  The caregivers were sent home from the building and a background check was submitted by the director.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: 2 out of 8 staff training records reviewed were missing documented training on emergency preparedness, preventing the spread of communicable disease, preventing and responding to emergencies due to food allergies, understanding building and physical premisis safety and handling, storing and disposing of hazardous waste.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: 2 out of 10 child immunization records reviewed did not contain updated immunization records.  One child, 3 yrs old, was missing their MMR and Varicella vaccines.   One child, 4 yrs of age, was missing their Varicella vaccine.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: 1 of the 2 vehicles utilized to transport children had a fire extinguisher that was registering empty.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operation's parent handbook did not contain information regarding the promotion of active play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: There was a Little Tykes play house on the large playground that had several panels that were no longer connected to each other.  There was also another play house on the smaller playground that had two panels that were not connected at the base of the house.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: The 3 year old classroom was observed sending a child to a restroom located outside of the classroom.  There was one caregiver present with 10 children and the caregiver walked out of the room to assist the child in the restroom leaving the classroom unattended.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))
